topic: Simon the cat's Dickin Medal after the HMS Amethyst siege
title: The Only Cat In History To Win A War Medal For Bravery
description: The true story of Simon, the only cat ever awarded Britain's Dickin Medal for animal bravery, after surviving a shell blast during the 1949 Yangtze Incident aboard HMS Amethyst. AI-narrated original commentary.

hook_candidates.text: A wounded ship's cat a besieged Navy crew depended on.
Britain has one medal for animal bravery, and only one cat has ever earned it.
What does it take for a cat to earn a real military medal?
Bravery medals in war aren't just for dogs and horses. One cat won one too.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who jokes their own cat would be useless in a crisis, because they want to prove one cat actually earned a war medal for real bravery.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume a wounded ship's cat couldn't really help an entire crew survive a siege.
closing_comment: Simon really is the only cat in history to win a war medal for bravery, and the crew loved him so much they named a rat after Mao Tse-tung.

sources.note: Confirms Simon was wounded by shell blast aboard HMS Amethyst, awarded the Dickin Medal, died in quarantine Nov 1949.
Confirms Simon is the only cat ever awarded the Dickin Medal.
